mapper.select: SELECT admin_id, login_id, password, salt, name, created_at FROM admins WHERE login_id = #{loginId} LIMIT 1

SELECT event_id, title, event_type, sido, sigungu, place_name, lat, lng, start_date, end_date, apply_start, apply_end, target, distances, fee_text, contact, homepage_url, status, source, source_url, approved_by, approved_at, collected_at FROM events WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO events (title, event_type, sido, sigungu, place_name, lat, lng, start_date, end_date, apply_start, apply_end, target, distances, fee_text, contact, homepage_url, status, source, source_url, collected_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{eventType}, #{sido}, #{sigungu}, #{placeName}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{applyStart}, #{applyEnd}, #{target}, #{distances}, #{feeText}, #{contact}, #{homepageUrl}, #{status}, #{source}, #{sourceUrl}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE events SET status = #{status}, approved_by = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN #{adminId} ELSE approved_by END, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN NOW() ELSE approved_at END WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.rental_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facility_sports fs WHERE fs.facility_id = f.facility_id) AS course_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facility_sports fs WHERE fs.facility_id = f.facility_id AND fs.reserve_url IS NOT NULL AND fs.reserve_url <> '') AS my_course_count FROM facilities f WHERE f.is_active = 1
AND f.gu_name = #{gu}
AND f.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND (f.homepage_url IS NULL OR f.homepage_url = '') AND (f.rental_url IS NULL OR f.rental_url = '')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facility_sports fs WHERE fs.facility_id = f.facility_id)
AND ((f.homepage_url IS NOT NULL AND f.homepage_url <> '') OR (f.rental_url IS NOT NULL AND f.rental_url <> ''))
ORDER BY f.gu_name, f.name LIMIT 300

SELECT f.facility_id, f.name, f.gu_name, f.road_addr, f.lot_addr, f.phone, f.homepage_url, f.rental_url, f.lat, f.lng, ds.site_url AS district_url, ds.rental_url AS district_rental_url FROM facilities f LEFT JOIN district_sites ds ON ds.gu_name = f.gu_name WHERE f.facility_id = #{facilityId}

SELECT s.sport_id AS sportId, s.name AS sportName, s.workout_mode AS workoutMode, fs.facility_id IS NOT NULL AS linked, fs.reserve_url AS reserveUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND p.sport_id = s.sport_id AND p.program_type = 'COURSE') AS courseCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM programs p WHERE p.facility_id = #{facilityId} AND p.sport_id = s.sport_id AND p.program_type <> 'COURSE') AS otherCnt FROM sports s LEFT JOIN facility_sports fs ON fs.sport_id = s.sport_id AND fs.facility_id = #{facilityId} WHERE s.is_active = 1 AND s.category = 'FACILITY' ORDER BY s.sport_id
SELECT DISTINCT gu_name FROM facilities WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY gu_name
mapper.update: UPDATE facilities SET homepage_url = NULLIF(TRIM(#{homepageUrl}), ''), rental_url = NULLIF(TRIM(#{rentalUrl}), '') WHERE facility_id = #{facilityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO facility_sports (facility_id, sport_id, reserve_url) VALUES (#{facilityId}, #{sportId}, NULLIF(TRIM(#{reserveUrl}), ''))
